title: phanera integrifolia subsp. nymphaeifolia
intro: Phanera integrifolia subsp. nymphaeifolia, commonly known as the Nymphaeifolia or Chinese Phanera, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Phanera integrifolia subsp. nymphaeifolia include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and diuretic effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis, kidney stones, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
